node_definition.done_when: Tests with a temporary repository and crew home show the following: A plan with no stored review: one call queues every section held plan-review-owed , and composes one design and one content review. Storing both reviews with no findings releases the sections on the next admission pass. A stored review with an unanswered finding keeps its section held, and answering the finding releases it. A second call while the reviews are in flight composes no further review. Negative control: the no-review call against the base revision refuses at dispatch with the review gate's refusal, and the failing run is logged. The gate runs on all_debug , and its log is written to docs/evidence/fragments/building-a-plan-queues-all-of-it/s3.html .
